text:
Maya: quick idea — propose we split Optimize toolkit launch into two parallel tracks: Advisor (customer-facing recs) and Ops (runbook + eval-alerts). keeps rollout risk low and lets us ship the batching/caching q2 bits earlier.
Leo: +1 on the split. can we make Advisor read-only for beta customers (no auto-apply)? less product risk. :thumbsup:
Sam: must clarify acceptance criteria per track. suggest these minimal gates: 1) Advisor: accuracy regressed <=1% on sentinel set, UI + API + docs, customer opt-in flow. 2) Ops: alert plumbing, playbook, canary config.
Jin: + follow-up — quant recommendations need an SLA-tier mapping. some customers expect 99th p99 latency guarantees, quant trades latency for perf. we should include a "safety profile" schema.
Maya: agreed. sketch of safety profile config:
```
profile: "conservative"
apply_auto: false
latency_p99_target_ms: 250
quant_bits: 8
fallback_model: "llama-2-13b-fp16"
```
this would be included in Advisor recommendations and used by Ops runbook for auto-fallbacks.
ops-bot: deploy-check: optimize-advisor service on staging passed smoke tests at 2024-11-08T16:12Z :white_check_mark:
Leo: also want eval-triggered alerts to be actionable. propose two kinds: "quality drift" (model-level metric drop) and "cost spike" (tokens-per-request unexpectedly up). both should surface suggested mitigations.
Anya: for drift alerts let's include the failing prompts + top 3 suggested mitigations, e.g., revert to previous model variant, tighten prompt constraints, or pin quantization off for requests matching pattern.
Sam: how about a compact rule DSL for alert criteria? short example: 
```
rule: "eval_drift_v1"
metric: "topk_accuracy"
threshold: "-0.02"
window: "7d"
actions: ["notify#product","suggest_revert","create-incident-draft"]
```
We can iterate on syntax but the point is machine-readable + UI-editable.
Maya: implementation notes — runtime needs to expose model variants + quant profile metadata per request so Ops can do fast fallbacks. this implies small headers in API responses: `x-rw-model, x-rw-quant-profile`.
Jin: risk callout — automatic fallback might cause cost spikes if descending to larger FP models. Ops runbook must include a cost-safety throttle.
Leo: next steps: 1) product to write acceptance checklist per track (Maya + Sam), 2) infra to prototype headers + fallback hooks (Jin), 3) research to test quant safety profiles on sentinel sets (Anya). sync Friday?
Maya: Friday works. I'll draft the two checklists today and post in #product-docs. short-term PR: add header instrumentation to the staging proxy so we can simulate fallback behavior.
Anya: I'll run a quick experiment with 3 customer workloads to get perf vs quality curves for bits=8/4/3 and post a short table.
Sam: tiny ask — can we ensure alerts include a link to the eval run that triggered them? makes triage much faster.
Maya: yes, add `eval_url` in the alert payload.
Leo: love it. wrapping up — prioritize: (A) headers + fallback hook, (B) eval->alert rule DSL + UI, (C) advisor opt-in flow + docs. thanks all. :rocket:
